name: Knuth-Bendix rewriting: universal algebra meets word problems
summary: Rewriting-system methods from universal algebra were applied to word problems, giving a computational route to normal forms in presented algebraic structures.

name: Fractal geometry: self-similarity, dimension and computer experiment (Mandelbrot)
summary: Mandelbrot combined self-similarity and fractional dimension to model coastlines and noise, defined fractals via Hausdorff dimension, and used computers to map Julia-set connectivity.

name: Bass-Serre theory
summary: Group actions on trees decompose groups as amalgams and HNN extensions.

name: Mixed Hodge theory (Deligne)
summary: Cohomology of singular or open varieties carries a weight filtration, extending Hodge theory and mirroring weights in the Weil conjectures.

name: Variation of Hodge structure and period domains (Griffiths)
to: complex algebraic geometry (variations of Hodge structure)
summary: Periods of integrals on algebraic manifolds vary holomorphically with transversality, giving an analytic tool for moduli and cycle questions.

name: Thermodynamic formalism for hyperbolic dynamics (Sinai, Ruelle, Bowen)
summary: Gibbs states from statistical mechanics describe invariant measures of hyperbolic systems, with pressure replacing free energy.

name: Rational homotopy theory via differential forms
summary: Homotopy types are encoded by commutative differential graded algebras of polynomial forms, so rational homotopy becomes homological algebra.

name: Elementary topos theory
summary: Categories with subobject classifiers served as generalised universes of sets.

name: Domain theory
summary: Continuous lattices gave models for the lambda calculus.

name: Chromatic homotopy theory and the nilpotence theorem
summary: Formal groups organise stable homotopy into chromatic layers, and the nilpotence theorem proves the Ravenel conjectures.
